items.description: When we use LLMs in a specialized domain, such as the operations of any reasonably-large organization, there is a lot of specialized vocabulary. Such words and specialized meanings will be foreign to an LLM because they aren't in its training set, making it harder for the LLM to be effective when doing tasks in that domain.

items.description: k6 v2.4.0 is here 🎉! This release includes: Experimental tracing of test runs, scenarios, VUs, and iterations. Ed25519 signatures and X25519 key agreement in WebCrypto. Credential-header redaction for HTTP and gRPC debug logs. Structured gRPC error details. Fixes for browser selectors, JavaScript memory leaks, and asynchronous error reporting.

items.description: Technical debt is not necessarily a sign of poor engineering. It can be the price of learning through software in use. As AI accelerates code production beyond our capacity to understand code and context, technical debt increasingly becomes a sociotechnical challenge. By Ben Linders

items.title: Presentation: Opening the Black Box: Critical Explainability for AI Agent Tool Selection with Kiji Inspector
items.summary: Hannes Hapke shares how Dataiku’s open-source Kiji Inspector applies Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) directly to decision tokens to expose why agents pick specific tools. Moving past superficial chain-of-t...
items.description: Hannes Hapke shares how Dataiku’s open-source Kiji Inspector applies Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) directly to decision tokens to expose why agents pick specific tools. Moving past superficial chain-of-thought narratives, he discusses causal ablation, layer activation extraction via patched vLLM engines, and production monitoring workflows for software architects and senior engineering leaders.

items.title: Azure Logic Apps Standard Gets a Local CLI in Preview
items.summary: Microsoft has released a public preview of the logicapp extension for the Azure CLI, adding local project creation, workflow authoring, a runtime lifecycle, connector management, run inspection, and t...
items.description: Microsoft has released a public preview of the logicapp extension for the Azure CLI, adding local project creation, workflow authoring, a runtime lifecycle, connector management, run inspection, and test scaffolding for Logic Apps Standard, work that previously required the VS Code extension. The product team pitches the terminal surface as determinism for AI-assisted development.

items.title: Google Open-Sources TPU Sync for KV Cache and Weight Transfer on TPUs
items.summary: Google Cloud has open-sourced TPU Sync, a native C++ library that moves KV cache blocks and model weights between TPU HBM, host DRAM, shared storage, and the data center network. By Daniel Dominguez
